def solve(g):
    from collections import deque
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if (i,j) not in seen:
                c=g[i][j]; q=deque([(i,j)]); seen.add((i,j)); cells=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy in(-1,0,1):
                        for dx in(-1,0,1):
                            ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                            if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and g[ny][nx]==c and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                                seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
                ys=[a for a,b in cells]; xs=[b for a,b in cells]
                t,l=min(ys),min(xs)
                pat=tuple(tuple(1 if (t+a,l+b) in set(cells) else 0 for b in range(max(xs)-l+1)) for a in range(max(ys)-t+1))
                comps.append((c,cells,pat))
    bg=max(((sum(1 for r in g for v in r if v==c),c) for c in {v for r in g for v in r}))[1]
    from collections import defaultdict
    groups=defaultdict(list)
    for c,cells,pat in comps:
        if c!=bg: groups[pat].append((c,cells))
    # pair: largest pattern group with >1 member
    pair=max((v for v in groups.values() if len(v)>1), key=lambda v: len(v[0][1]))
    # marker: color with exactly one comp, not bg, not in pair colors
    cnt=defaultdict(int)
    for c,cells,pat in comps:
        if c!=bg: cnt[c]+=1
    mcands=[c for c,n in cnt.items() if n==1 and all(c!=pc for pc,_ in pair)]
    # choose marker: L-shaped (bar+tail) -> largest bbox asymmetry; use cells count as tiebreak heuristic:
    def shape_cells(c):
        return [x for x in comps if x[0]==c][0][1]
    marker=max(mcands, key=lambda c: len(shape_cells(c)))
    mcells=shape_cells(marker)
    def mind(cells): return min(abs(a-y)+abs(b-x) for a,b in cells for y,x in mcells)
    # change the member farther from marker
    d=[mind(cells) for c,cells in pair]
    tgt=pair[d.index(max(d))][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for y,x in tgt: out[y][x]=marker
    return out
